author: visegrad24
text:
25-year-old Sudanese migrant Samir A. living illegally in France despite a deportation order has been charged after brutally beating, robbing, and killing frenchman Étienne D., 31, near Paris. Étienne was found unconscious with multiple facial injuries and a severe traumatic brain injury. He later died in hospital.

Samir was known to police under around 10 different identities.

There has been a slew of Sudanese migrant crime cases in recent months, with the attempted beheading of a local man in Belfast as the most infamous case.

More and more Sudanese asylum seekers are arriving in Europe as the civil war in Sudan has entered its 4th year, and many internally displaced people have lost hope of being able to return home anytime soon.

Many of the Sudanese asylum seekers have been living in areas under the control of the Qatar-backed Muslim Brotherhood-allied Sudanese Armed Forces and have been brainwashed with Islamist propaganda calling for violence against “non-believers.”
